_draft: Doc 33 content drafts (2026-10-12). Not loaded by the app. Each block moves into bundle.json under the same key when its increment lands; ids are canonical now. Lines are first drafts for the owner's edit pass.

characters.notes: Colossus Gym floor. Excessive: every answer is more gym or more food. Never named.
Protein Row. Brisk, already leaving. Never named.

characters.display_name: The old man at the shake stand
characters.notes: Protein Row. Slow, cryptic; the L4 beat already points at him. Never named.

held_lines.speaker: guide.elder
held_lines.line: The floor is still waiting. Go walk it before I say anything else.

held_lines.speaker: guide.elder
held_lines.line: You haven't been down the stairs yet. I'll wait.

held_lines.speaker: guide.elder
held_lines.line: He's down there. Don't make him wait longer than you need to.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: It is. And it's not just your eyes now. Look down.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: The first one was the city noticing you. This one is you noticing back.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: As far as you take it. That's the part nobody warns you about.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Some of them in there have chased this for eleven years. You've been here ten days.

sets.offer: Humour an old man. There's a bar in the alley nobody can shift. Shift it.
sets.win: Huh. Further than I ever got it.
sets.lose: It beat me too, once. Come back heavier.

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Don't tell anyone on the Row. They'll want to see it done again.

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: The bar's been there longer than the alley. No shame in it.

sets.offer: Walk with me. I'll set the pace, you keep it. No talking.
sets.win: You kept it. I didn't think you would.
sets.lose: You dropped off at the overpass. The overpass gets everyone.

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: I walk that stretch every night. It took me a year to stop noticing it.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: How long will it take me?

sets.offer: Half the signs on the Row are wrong. Tell me which half.
sets.win: Every one. Who taught you to read a street?
sets.lose: You trusted the big ones. The big ones are the lies.

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: The small signs are older. Somebody still fixes them at night.

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: I was hoping you'd find out.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: The Gym sign is the biggest one on the street.

sets.offer: Sit with me until the rain changes. Don't ask how long.
sets.win: You didn't move. Most people ask twice in the first minute.
sets.lose: You asked. Everyone asks. Try again when you don't need to know.

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: It did. You'll notice next time without me.

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: The rain down here changes about once an hour. Nobody's ever sat the full hour on the first try.

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: One. He's in the Gym now. Make of that what you like.

sets.offer: Spot me. If you can't hold it, nobody will know. I'll know.
sets.win: You held it. Okay. Okay. I need to go lift immediately.
sets.lose: Knew it. You need to eat. Like, now. Chicken. All of it.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter
lines: Nobody's held that for me since the big guy.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter
lines: Eat something. We don't talk about him on the floor.

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter
lines: Not your fault. Your arms are just... small. We fix that. Eight hours a day, you'll see.

sets.offer: Back again? Good. Spot me. Heavier than last time, obviously.
sets.win: Held it again. I'm going to add a plate and cry about it later.
sets.lose: Slipped. It's fine. It's the chicken. You're not eating the chicken.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter
lines: You know what you need? More of this. Every day. Twice.

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter
lines: I'm going to write you a meal plan. It's just the word chicken, forty times.

sets.offer: One more plate than you can do. That's the only set that counts.
sets.win: ...You did it. I have to tell someone. There's no one to tell.
sets.lose: That's the plate everyone misses. I missed it for a year. Then I stopped doing anything else.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter
lines: He'd have liked that. He'd have asked for one more.

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter
lines: You'll get it. Then there's another one. That's the good news.

sets.offer: Race you up the floors. Lifters don't run. Don't tell anyone I asked.
sets.win: You beat me. I'm going to be sick. Cardio's a scam. I'm doing cardio from now on.
sets.lose: Told you. Legs are for standing under the bar.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter
lines: Is that what outside feels like? Air?

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter
lines: Don't feel bad. I've been up these stairs four thousand times. Never past the door though.

sets.offer: Package for the overpass. It beats the rain or it doesn't count. You carry it.
sets.win: Dry. Huh. Most of my packages aren't.
sets.lose: Wet. It's fine. Half the district's addresses are wet.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.row.courier
lines: You run like someone who's been somewhere.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.row.courier
lines: Nobody down here does. Doesn't slow the deliveries.

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.row.courier
lines: Overpass gets everyone the first time. Second time you know where the puddle is.

sets.offer: There's a block on the map that doesn't end. I need someone to find out if that's true.
sets.win: It ends. You're the first to tell me that. I'm not sure I believe you.
sets.lose: You came back. That's the usual result.

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: A door. Someone's name on it.

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.row.courier
lines: I've crossed it off the map twice. It keeps coming back.

sets.offer: You asked me who built the Gym. I'll ask you back. Think before you answer.
sets.win: Correct. And wrong. Both. Sit down a moment.
sets.lose: That's what everyone says. That's why he's still in there.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.row.shake_stand
lines: He didn't build it. He outgrew it. The building just kept up.

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.row.shake_stand
lines: Come back when you've been inside. Answers taste different after.

sets.offer: Drink this slowly. The whole thing. If you check the time, you've lost.
sets.win: You didn't look. Good. Most people on this street can't finish a glass without checking what they missed.
sets.lose: You looked. Twice. The shake's still fine.

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.row.shake_stand
lines: He used to drink one every morning. Standing. Watching the door.

quest.colossus_gym_01.speaker: hero
lines: One of them asked how long I've been coming.

quest.colossus_gym_01.speaker: hero
lines: I said not long. He said that's what he said.

quest.colossus_gym_01.speaker: hero
lines: I didn't look at the stairs today.

quest.colossus_gym_02.speaker: hero
lines: The logbook had a new page.

quest.colossus_gym_02.speaker: hero
lines: Someone down there asked me to spot them. They didn't say thanks. They said "again".

quest.colossus_gym_03.speaker: hero
lines: I trained next to him. Neither of us said anything.

quest.colossus_gym_03.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Then you both said the same thing.

pages.description: First day. Bench felt light. Ate until it hurt. Good.
Added the vest. Can't feel the stairs any more. Good.
The old man on the Row says I should go home sometimes. Added a plate instead.
They put my name on the sign. Asked for it bigger.
Lost the week. Don't know where. Hit the floor harder to make up for it.
A kid asked me what the point was. Told him: more. He wrote it down. Good.
Can't remember why I started. Doesn't matter. Added a plate.
Someone new on the floor today. Looked at the stairs. They all do.

lines: Thirty minutes under load. There's a whole building of people doing this. Don't become the building.
Lift. Then come back. Both halves count.
Thirty minutes. Stronger isn't the problem. Remember that.
Train. He'd do eleven hours. Do thirty and go home.
Go train. Just come home when you're done.
Thirty minutes. I know how it ends now. So do you.
Take the long way. Tell me if you see that door again.
Twenty minutes. If the door's there, don't open it. Just tell me.
Forty-five minutes. And yes, I know what the Runner would say. Ignore him.
Longer one. The Hill has runners who never stop. You can stop.

rumours.text: Someone on the Row swears the Gym's sign got bigger overnight. Nobody measured it.
The Test MAX place changed its slogan again. Nobody can remember the old one.
A courier says there's a block past the overpass that doesn't end. Couriers say a lot.
The shake stand's been there longer than the street, apparently. The old man won't say which came first.
Somebody saw the sunglasses man blink. Nobody believes them.
The rain on the Row stops for nobody. Except, people say, once.
Three people went into the Gym last week. Two came out. The third is "still training".
They say the lower floor plays music. Nobody who's been down there remembers hearing it.
A lifter on the floor has been doing the same set since Tuesday. Nobody's sure which Tuesday.
Someone left a logbook page on the crates outside. Blank except the date. Tomorrow's.
The Gym's front desk never asks for a name. Someone asked why. The desk said you'll give it anyway.
People say Colossus hasn't left the building in a year. People also say the building's been getting bigger.
